dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Seahawks (6-4) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of 49ers
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Mike Macdonald and the medical staff evaluate CB Terrion Arnold (personal), G Quenton Nelson (knee), OT Charles Cross (ankle), and DT Leonard Williams (shoulder) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Mookie Alexander](https://www.fieldgulls.com/seattle-seahawks-injury-report/180742/seahawks-injury-update-quenton-nelson-abe-lucas-ruled-out-49ers).

Week 12 49ers Outlook: Mike Macdonald and DC Aden Durde open installation for the San Francisco 49ers (9-1, SF -2.5, HC Kyle Shanahan, OC Klay Kubiak & DC Raheem Morris (Road Test))—a unit ranked #1 in Points / Game (31.6) as Seattle prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Adam Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2125347926977413196) [Brady Henderson](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50578357/seahawks-holding-final-sam-darnold-call-vs-49ers).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 6-4 (3rd in NFC West • #8 Seed in NFC), Seattle carries a 50.5% postseason projection, 5.5% NFC West division title mark, and 1.1% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Mookie Alexander](https://www.fieldgulls.com/seattle-seahawks-game-analysis/180723/where-seahawks-still-elite-defense-has-fallen-off-2025-nfl-stats).

Around the Beat: As the Seattle Seahawks prepare to welcome Sam Darnold back into the starting lineup, their Week 12 opponents could be missing their MVP favorite quarterback [Mookie Alexander](https://www.fieldgulls.com/seattle-seahawks-news/180737/49ers-brock-purdy-injury-update-ankle-seahawks-game-nfl-news).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Seattle ranks #16 in Points / Game (22.3), #4 in Points Allowed / Game (17.5), #24 in Turnover Differential (-3), giving Mike Macdonald and Aden Durde a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 1:25 PM PST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the San Francisco 49ers [Mookie Alexander](https://www.fieldgulls.com/seattle-seahawks-game-analysis/180723/where-seahawks-still-elite-defense-has-fallen-off-2025-nfl-stats).
